plugins.name: eli5
plugins.description: Explain any topic like I'm 5: a dead-simple HTML picture explainer with big visuals and few words. Use /eli5 <topic>.

plugins.name: html-plan
plugins.description: Write an implementation plan as one interactive HTML page: a tree of claims, each proved by a mockup, state machine, call stack, schema or code, with the decisions you need to make placed where they matter. Use /html-plan <what to build>.
